purpose: Measure original-vocal quality with ACE-Step thinking and no prompt rewriting.
identity_policy: Original fictional vocalist; no artist imitation and no reference audio.

engine.name: ACE-Step 1.5
engine.working_tree_note: Existing user changes are preserved; the runner records whether the tree is dirty.

request.prompt: Original late-night retro soul song, intimate low female alto with a textured lived-in voice, clear English diction, restrained horn stabs, upright bass, brushed drums, Wurlitzer piano, warm analog tape, spacious but controlled mix.
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights fade into the rain
The last train hums my name
I kept the door held by a chain
Now morning knows my shame

[Chorus]
Let the blue hour roll
Carry sparks out of my soul
I will never borrow another face
I will sing in my own name and place
